contents.DefaultText:
Hello everyone!

No update yet, this is a news announcement.


We have decided to postpone the swamp update. 
We were planning to release it in two parts ( part today, part two weeks later) but we have recently come to the conclusion that it would be better to publish one bigger update two weeks from now than two smaller less impactful ones. 

With that out of the way, I'd like to take this opportunity to update you a bit on our plans for the rest of the year (and the beginnings of the next one)!

<size=150%>Swamp Update:</size>

What we'll be releasing 2 weeks from now.
This update will be increasing the map size considerably (20 new areas) and introducing a new biome (the swamp). The swamp has dam-building beavers, leeches, eels, ducks and some new resources such as bog myrtle, peat, alder and most importantly bog iron.  It also has 4 new landmarks with some special mechanics as well as paths that flood depending on the water level.
Iron is a complex metal that has to be processed in specific ways and cannot be cast or alloyed (at the current technology level). Iron tools will have the potential to be a lot stronger than tin bronze at high metal quality, and will open the way to better woodworking and eventually mechanical devices (like mills) in future updates.

<size=150%>NPC Update:</size>

We're planning for this to be the update after the swamp one. It will introduce the NPC creator as well as the possibility to encounter NPCs in-game.
The NPC creator is similar to the character one and should allow players to design the personalities, looks and traits of their NPCs.
This first version of human NPCs will be able to do a good amount of tasks for you, and will already come with a working relationship system for friendship and romance. After this we will continue to update NPCs with more tasks and polishing their systems.
This is a big update but we also think it's something card survival really needs and we want to have it in as soon as possible.


These two updates are the ones coming next, and after we're dividing the coming content into a few different blocks that we are planning to release over the rest of the year (and the first half of 2027) in no particular order/priority:

<size=150%>Construction:</size>

New buildings such as stilt houses and stone structures, swamp paths, cliff stairs, as well as the capacity to finally destroy buildings.
Advanced infrastructure to control water flow, cave improvements and automated structures such as mills (wind, water or human/animal powered).
Rafts and boats for transportation.

<size=150%>Magic:</size>

We will be introducing a ritual to create familiars, the ability to create wards and home spirits, curses, foresight and other new magical blueprints and rituals. We will also use this opportunity to deepen and improve some of the psychological/spiritual system and add a good number of new spirits and landmarks. Among the spirits we have planned there are ghosts, spirit traders, location haunts, guardian spirits and unique animals. Many of these will offer special mechanics that will only come into play during the second or third year.

<size=150%>Life:</size>

We have many planned features to enrich player life in the forest. Here we intend to release honey, beekeeping, sweets and more advanced bakery as well as more advanced methods for alcohol distillation, brews and alchemy. We're also planning to release NPC improvements around this time to enable family making and allow them to participate in combat as allies.

<size=150%>Animals:</size>

We're planning to introduce donkeys, mules and oxes as mounts/pack animals and farm help. We're also going to be adding dogs and cats as pets and animal pests such as crows and mice. Sheep are also coming here, which will be used for their wool, milk and meat.

<size=150%>Mountain:</size>

Another map expansion with many new location including permanently snowed places, areas that can only be accessed by climbing, great places for skiing and many caves.
In addition to this, we'll be releasing improvements to the temperature and weather system. We are also planning to release improvements to the mining system here as well as new metals such as silver, gold, lead and new sources for iron.

<size=150%>New Characters (Fates):</size>

The next characters we're planning to release are the Witch, which starts with a hut in the swamp and whose adventure has involves mostly dealing with spirits, and the Tourist, which will start on top of the new mountain area with very little resources and will have to start a new life in this new place and time.


That's all for now.
Let us know if you'd like to see any of this content in particular, and it might help us adjust our priorities. ;)
See you all for the swamp/iron update!
contents.Text:
大家好！

目前还没有更新，这是一则公告。

我们决定推迟沼泽更新。我们原本计划分两部分发布（第一部分今天，第二部分两周后），但我们最近得出结论，两周后发布一个更大的更新，比发布两个较小、影响较低的更新要好。
说完这件事，我想借此机会向大家介绍一下我们今年剩余时间（以及明年初）的计划！

<size=150%>沼泽更新：</size>
我们将在两周后发布的内容。
这次更新将大幅扩大地图（新增20个区域），并引入一个新的生物群系（沼泽）。沼泽里有筑坝的河狸、水蛭、鳗鱼、鸭子，以及一些新资源，例如香桃木、泥炭、桤木，最重要的是沼泽铁矿。它还有4个带有特殊机制的新地标，以及会根据水位涨落的小路。
铁是一种复杂的金属，需要用特定方式加工，不能铸造或合金化（以目前的技术水平）。在高金属品质下，铁制工具有潜力比锡青铜强得多，并将为更好的木工技术以及未来更新中的机械装置（如磨坊）铺平道路。

<size=150%>NPC更新：</size>

我们计划在沼泽更新之后推出这个更新。它将引入NPC创建器，以及在游戏中遇到NPC的可能性。
NPC创建器与角色创建器类似，应该允许玩家设计NPC的性格、外貌和特质。
这第一版本的人类NPC将能够为你完成相当数量的任务，并已附带一个可运作的友谊与恋爱关系系统。之后我们将继续更新NPC，添加更多任务并完善其系统。
这是一个大型更新，但我们也认为这是"卡牌求生"真正需要的东西，我们希望尽快将其加入游戏。


这两个更新是接下来要发布的，之后我们将把未来的内容划分为几个不同的板块，计划在今年剩余时间（以及2027年上半年）以不特定的顺序/优先级发布：

<size=150%>建造：</size>
新建筑，例如高脚屋和石质建筑、沼泽小路、悬崖台阶，以及终于可以拆除建筑的功能。
用于控制水流的高级基础设施、洞穴改进，以及自动化建筑，例如磨坊（风力、水力或人力/畜力驱动）。
用于交通运输的木筏和船只。

<size=150%>魔法：</size>
我们将引入创造魔宠的仪式、创造结界和家宅灵的能力、诅咒、预知以及其他新的魔法蓝图和仪式。我们也将借此机会深化和改进一些心理/灵性系统，并加入相当数量的新灵体和地标。在我们计划的灵体中，有鬼魂、灵体商人、地点灵魂、守护灵和独特动物。其中许多将提供只在第二或第三年才会发挥作用的特殊机制。

<size=150%>生活：</size>
我们有许多计划功能来丰富玩家在森林中的生活。这里我们打算加入蜂蜜、养蜂、甜食和更高级的烘焙，以及更高级的酿酒蒸馏、酿造和炼金术。我们也计划在此期间发布NPC改进，以实现组建家庭的功能，并让他们作为盟友参与战斗。

<size=150%>动物：</size>
我们计划引入驴、骡和牛作为坐骑/驮畜和农场帮手。我们还将加入狗和猫作为宠物，以及乌鸦和老鼠等动物害虫。绵羊也会在这里加入，可用于羊毛、羊奶和羊肉。

<size=150%>山脉：</size>
另一次地图扩展，包含许多新地点，包括常年积雪的地方、只能通过攀爬才能进入的区域、极佳的滑雪场所以及许多洞穴。
除此之外，我们将发布温度和天气系统的改进。我们还计划在这里发布采矿系统的改进，以及新金属，例如银、金、铅，以及新的铁矿来源。

<size=150%>新角色（命运）：</size>
我们下一步计划发布的角色是女巫，她从沼泽中的小屋出发，冒险主要涉及与灵体打交道；以及旅行者，他将从新山区的顶部出发，几乎没有任何资源，必须在这个新地点和新时代重新开始生活。


以上就是目前的全部内容。
如果你们特别想看到某些内容，欢迎告诉我们，这可能会帮助我们调整优先级。😉

沼泽/铁器更新，我们不见不散！
